result.title: Modeling Deletion Requests in Machine Unlearning
result.summary: Machine unlearning is seen as a promising approach to enable users to exercise the "right to erasure" in the context of AI models. We ask how users might influence the behavior of models when exercising this right. We define two types of behaviors that users might adopt when requesting the deletion of their data: adaptivity and collectivity. Drawing connections between the goals of users in this context and results in stochastic optimization, we demonstrate theoretical gaps between the potential effects of groups of users who do and do not display these behaviors. We then show how techniques from data valuation might be used to design deletion requesters that can significantly alter model behavior in realistic settings. In experiments on computer vision tasks, we demonstrate the differential effects of different models of user behavior and attempt to isolate the impacts of adaptivity and collectivity.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究机器遗忘场景下用户删除请求的行为建模，定义「自适应性」与「集体性」两类用户行为，借助随机优化的理论结果分析群体删除请求对模型行为的影响，并用数据估值方法设计能显著改变模型行为的删除请求者，在计算机视觉任务上验证不同用户行为模型的差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究的是数据删除权利与遗忘中的用户行为及数据估值，虽涉及计算机视觉任务，但未触及视觉细节保留、latent 推理状态生成与使用、THINK/LOOK/STOP 决策等问题，与 LVR 主线无实质联系；「数据估值影响模型行为」或可极远地类比训练数据贡献分配，但缺乏具体可迁移线索。
